schema: same as the aircraft items of docs/data/mobili.json (regole/02_schema-dati.md v2.1 + map extras); extra fields istantanea, n_aerei
nota: Military aircraft. Items with istantanea=1 are an automatic ADS-B snapshot taken at the time in ora_utc: positions are where the aircraft were at collection time, not live, and many military aircraft fly with transponders off, so absence means nothing. Snapshot data: adsb.lol contributors (ODbL 1.0) and adsb.fi (https://adsb.fi, personal non-commercial use). The other items are curated deployments from open sources (last ~60 days), placed at the base named by the source, with base coordinates from OurAirports.

punti.nome: 12 B-1B Lancers left RAF Fairford
punti.note: US European Command confirmed on 4 October that all US bombers deployed to RAF Fairford had redeployed to their home stations. The New York Times, citing two US officials, put the number at 12 B-1Bs. Six B-52s had left the base earlier in 2026. No reason was given; it followed arrests near the base on 27 September (UKDJ). The point marks the base the bombers left, not aircraft present. Base coordinates: OurAirports (EGVA).

punti.nome: 10 KC-135s relocated away from RAF Mildenhall
punti.note: Flight tracking analysed by CNN: 10 KC-135 tankers relocated away from Mildenhall on 9 November (4 to Spangdahlem, 1 to Ramstein, 4 to Morón, 1 to Glasgow Prestwick). The WSJ reported an Iran-related threat; force protection at Mildenhall and Lakenheath raised to FPCON Charlie. UK MoD: assets move according to operational requirements. Base coordinates: OurAirports (EGUN).

punti.nome: 4 KC-135s arrived at Spangdahlem from Mildenhall
punti.note: Destination of 4 of the 10 KC-135s moved out of RAF Mildenhall on 9 November, according to CNN's flight-tracking analysis. BBC Verify (via Breitbart) says some flew circuits over Aviano before landing at Spangdahlem. Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETAD).

punti.nome: 1 KC-135 arrived at Ramstein from Mildenhall
punti.note: One of the 10 KC-135s moved out of RAF Mildenhall on 9 November landed at Ramstein (CNN flight-tracking analysis). Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETAR).

punti.nome: 4 KC-135s arrived at Morón from Mildenhall
punti.note: Four of the 10 KC-135s moved out of RAF Mildenhall on 9 November went to Morón, Spain (CNN flight-tracking analysis). Base coordinates: OurAirports (LEMO).

punti.nome: 1 KC-135 diverted to Glasgow Prestwick
punti.note: One of the 10 KC-135s moved out of RAF Mildenhall on 9 November landed at Prestwick (CNN; BBC Verify via Breitbart). Base coordinates: OurAirports (EGPK).

punti.nome: 3 CV-22 Ospreys moved from Mildenhall to Lakenheath
punti.note: Three US Osprey tiltrotors left RAF Mildenhall and arrived at RAF Lakenheath on Tuesday 10 November, according to CBS News as reported by Breitbart. Second-hand report; not an airlifter in the strategic sense. Base coordinates: OurAirports (EGUL).

punti.nome: KC-135Rs flying to Tel Aviv (Ben Gurion)
punti.note: Flightradar24 data reported by Misbar: KC-135R 58-0128 (from the north-eastern US) and KC-135R 62-3576 (from RAF Mildenhall) crossed Europe and the Mediterranean on 7 November with Tel Aviv (TLV) as listed destination. Landing not shown in the report: the point is the listed destination. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LLBG).

punti.nome: KC-135T RCH5017 reached NAS Sigonella
punti.note: KC-135T 58-0062 flew RCH5017 from the United States over Ireland, the UK, France and Italy to Sigonella on 7 November (Flightradar24 data reported by Misbar). Base coordinates: OurAirports (LICZ).

punti.nome: RQ-4B Global Hawk back at Sigonella
punti.note: USAF RQ-4B 11-2046, callsign RICO28, crossed the Atlantic and the western Mediterranean and approached Sigonella on 9 November: its first appearance in ItaMilRadar's records since 2 February. Misbar tracked the same callsign on the transatlantic leg. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LICZ).

punti.nome: NATO RQ-4D Phoenix resumes flights from Sigonella
punti.note: After a long absence from public tracking, NATO's RQ-4D Phoenix flew as MAGMA10 from Sigonella east over the Ionian Sea on 3 November; destination unknown (Black Sea or Baltic possible, per the source). A 16 September Black Sea mission had been aborted after a radio failure. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LICZ).

punti.nome: C-17 airlift from Ramstein toward the eastern Mediterranean
punti.note: On 7 November three C-17As left Ramstein over central and south-eastern Europe toward the eastern Mediterranean (Misbar, Flightradar24). On 4-5 November Misbar tracked C-17s RCH533, RCH290, RCH723 and C-5M RCH2102 leaving Ramstein on the same corridor, and RCH5073 arriving from the US. Final destinations not shown. Ramstein acts as the staging hub of the air bridge to CENTCOM. Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETAR).

punti.nome: C-17 from Spangdahlem toward the eastern Mediterranean
punti.note: C-17A 09-9211 (RCH4977) left Spangdahlem on 7 November over Austria, Romania and Greece toward the eastern Mediterranean (Misbar, Flightradar24). Final destination not shown. Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETAD).

punti.nome: E-11A BACN relay aircraft left Ramstein for the Middle East
punti.note: USAF Bombardier E-11A 12-9506, a Battlefield Airborne Communications Node aircraft, was tracked departing Ramstein for the Middle East between 7 and 8 November (Misbar). Not strictly a reconnaissance aircraft: it links tactical data networks. The point is the departure base. Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETAR).

punti.nome: US KC-135Rs operating from Bucharest Otopeni
punti.note: On 22 September three KC-135Rs launched from Bucharest to Spangdahlem to escort 12 F-16Cs to the Gulf; on 29 September KC-135R 57-1453 (CLEAN94) left Bucharest to escort six F-16Cs from Aviano. Tracking data via ItaMilRadar and @DefenceGeek. How many tankers are based there is not stated. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LROP).

punti.nome: 12 F-16Cs (138th FW) left Spangdahlem for the Gulf
punti.note: Twelve F-16Cs of the Oklahoma Air National Guard's 138th Fighter Wing, staged at Spangdahlem for about a week, left on 22 September in three cells of four toward the Gulf (CENTCOM) with three KC-135Rs. Final base in the Gulf not given. The point is the staging base. Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETAD).

punti.nome: F-16Cs moving through Aviano to CENTCOM
punti.note: Coronet East 116: 12 F-16Cs from the US staged through Lajes and Aviano toward CENTCOM. The second group of six (93rd FS 'Makos', 482nd FW, TABOR41-46) left Aviano on 29 September with KC-135R CLEAN94. Earlier in September Aviano-based F-16s had returned from several weeks in the Middle East. Aviano is used as an intermediate hub. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LIPA).

punti.nome: EA-37B Compass Call moved from Ramstein to Souda Bay
punti.note: USAF EA-37B 19-1587 (FAZE21) flew overnight from Ramstein to Souda Bay on 7-8 October, hours after reports that the White House asked for Iran strike options before the 3 November midterms. Electronic-warfare aircraft, drawn here with the reconnaissance symbol. The source stresses the move does not mean an operation was authorised. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LGSA).

punti.nome: RC-135V/W Rivet Joint rotation between Mildenhall and Souda Bay
punti.note: On 9 October ItaMilRadar saw two operational Rivet Joints and a TC-135W trainer moving between RAF Mildenhall, Souda Bay and the US, consistent with a rotation of RC-135s used over the Middle East and the Gulf. Tracking alone cannot confirm the handover. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LGSA).

punti.nome: RAF RC-135W Rivet Joint flying Black Sea missions from Souda Bay
punti.note: RAF RC-135W ZZ666 flew from Souda Bay to the Black Sea on 7, 9, 12, 14 and 16 September, with orbits south of Crimea, and returned to Souda on 17 September after a week of missions. Later seen over Poland (14 October) and the Black Sea (3 November). Base coordinates: OurAirports (LGSA).

punti.nome: Italian ATR P-72A deployed to Souda Bay
punti.note: Italian Air Force P-72A MM62298 has been at Souda Bay since Friday 16 October; on 18 October it flew a two-hour surveillance mission south of Cyprus. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LGSA).

punti.nome: Italian E-550 CAEW over the Black Sea near the Danube Delta
punti.regione: north-western Black Sea, off the Danube Delta
punti.note: E-550 CAEW MM62293 flew from Pratica di Mare to the Danube Delta area on 3 November, at the same time as a British RC-135W and the US Army ARTEMIS II. On 29 October the same aircraft operated near the Romanian coast with ADS-B off amid heavy electronic interference. Centre of the area estimated from the source's description.

punti.nome: RAF RC-135W over the Black Sea
punti.note: A British RC-135W Rivet Joint operated over the Black Sea on 3 November together with an Italian CAEW and the US Army ARTEMIS II (ItaMilRadar). Exact orbit not given: wide area, estimated centre.

punti.nome: US Army ARTEMIS II over the Black Sea
punti.note: The US Army's Bombardier CL-650 ARTEMIS II (N159L) flew over the Black Sea on 3 November; on 14 October it operated over Poland and the Baltic, on 14 September off Tobruk, Libya. Wide area, estimated centre.

punti.nome: US Navy P-8A patrols from Varna over the western Black Sea
punti.note: US Navy P-8A 170269 departed Varna on 4 November for patrols off the Bulgarian coast; it had patrolled inside Bulgaria's EEZ on 31 October and on the evening of 24 October, amid drone attacks on merchant ships in the western Black Sea. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LBWN).

punti.nome: NATO E-3A AWACS sorties from Geilenkirchen
punti.note: A NATO E-3A left Geilenkirchen on 4 November for the Black Sea and south-eastern Europe. NATO E-3As were also tracked over the eastern flank on 21 October and over Italy during Steadfast Noon on 20 October. Main operating base of the NATO AWACS fleet. Base coordinates: OurAirports (ETNG).

punti.nome: NATO MMF A330 MRTT tanker sorties from Cologne
punti.note: Multinational MRTT Fleet A330 MRTTs flew from Cologne to the Black Sea on 22 October (T-056) and 4 November; T-058 refuelled over the Tyrrhenian Sea during Steadfast Noon on 13 October. Cologne is a forward operating location; the fleet's main base is Eindhoven. Base coordinates: OurAirports (EDDK).

punti.nome: French A330 MRTT from Istres refuelling over the Black Sea
punti.note: French A330 MRTT F-UJCO left Istres on 22 October and flew refuelling patterns over the western Black Sea, with receivers not visible on public tracking. French Air and Space Force photos released on 7 November show an MRTT refuelling an Italian F-35B over western Poland during October exercises. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LFMI).

punti.nome: Allied ISR and AWACS over Poland and the Baltic
punti.identificativo: French E-3F, Turkish E-7T, RAF RC-135W ZZ666, US Army ARTEMIS II
punti.note: On 14 October ItaMilRadar tracked a US Army ARTEMIS II, an RAF RC-135W, a French E-3F and a Turkish E-7T over and around Poland and the Baltic. Wide area, estimated centre; aircraft of four nations grouped as NATO.
punti.dettaglio: AWACS and SIGINT aircraft, several nations

punti.nome: RAF P-8A Poseidon over the northern Baltic
punti.note: RAF P-8A ZP806 operated over the northern Baltic on 21 October, alongside a Swedish S102B Korpen SIGINT jet over northern Europe and a NATO E-3A. Estimated centre of the area.

punti.nome: Swedish S102B Korpen flew Black Sea missions from Bucharest
punti.note: Swedish Air Force Gulfstream S102B Korpen 102003 flew from Linköping to Bucharest on 5 October, flew Black Sea sorties on 6, 7 and 8 October and returned to Sweden on 9 October. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LROP).

punti.nome: Turkish E-7T Wedgetail from Konya on a western route
punti.note: Turkish E-7T 13-004 left Konya on 6 October westward over the Balkans, vanished from tracking for about four hours and reappeared over the Ionian Sea; mission area unconfirmed. A Turkish E-7T also flew over Poland on 14 October. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LTAN).

punti.nome: Italian KC-767A tankers at Pratica di Mare
punti.regione: Pratica di Mare Air Base, Rome
punti.note: Only three of Italy's four KC-767As have been active recently: MM62226 last seen at Pratica di Mare on 20 October, MM62229 on 18 October, MM62227 at Pisa on 19 October; the fourth has not been tracked since 7 September. Six A330 MRTTs were ordered in 2026. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LIRE).

punti.nome: Steadfast Noon: allied tankers over the Tyrrhenian Sea
punti.identificativo: KC-767A BREUS93, A400M 54+44, A330 MRTT T-058
punti.regione: Tyrrhenian Sea, west of the Italian peninsula
punti.note: NATO's annual nuclear-deterrence exercise Steadfast Noon, hosted by Italy, ran from 13 to about 20 October. Tracked support aircraft: an Italian KC-767A, a German A400M, a NATO MRTT, a NATO E-3A and an Italian CAEW; fighters not visible on public tracking. No live nuclear weapons. Exercise area, estimated centre.
punti.dettaglio: tankers and support aircraft, NATO exercise

punti.nome: Italian SPYDR SIGINT aircraft operating from Pantelleria
punti.note: Italian King Air 350ER SPYDR MM62300 arrived at Pantelleria from Pratica di Mare on 3 November after a Baltic deployment and flew missions on 4 and 5 November; part of each flight was not visible, possibly off Libya (unconfirmed). Base coordinates: OurAirports (LICG).

punti.nome: Hellenic Navy P-3B Orion back over the Aegean
punti.note: A modernised Hellenic Navy P-3B (153415) left Elefsis on 2 November for a patrol over the Aegean. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LGEL).

punti.nome: US Army ARTEMIS II orbits off Tobruk, Libya
punti.note: On 14 September the US Army ARTEMIS II flew ISR orbits off Cyrenaica near Tobruk, which the source links to questions about Russian activity in eastern Libya. Estimated centre.

punti.nome: Italian Eurofighters on Baltic air policing at Šiauliai
punti.identificativo: Task Force Air Baltic Thunder III
punti.note: Four Italian Eurofighters took over the Baltic mission at Šiauliai on 31 July. Shortly after midnight on 15 September they shot down a drone that entered Lithuania from the direction of Belarus; wreckage found near Pratkūnai, Kaunas region (Lithuanian Armed Forces, via ItaMilRadar). Base coordinates: OurAirports (EYSA).

punti.nome: Turkish F-16s on Baltic air policing at Ämari
punti.note: Five Turkish F-16s and 76 personnel of the 181st Squadron hold the Baltic mission at Ämari from 1 August to 30 November 2026. They scrambled early on 1 September after drones crossed into Estonia; no shots fired. Last dated report is 1 September, so the map may show it as expired although the rotation is scheduled to last until 30 November. Base coordinates: OurAirports (EEEI).

punti.nome: Spanish F-18Ms on enhanced air policing at Mihail Kogălniceanu
punti.note: Spain's Paznic detachment (about 200 personnel, seven F-18Ms, an A400M for the first two months, three counter-drone NH90s later) began a four-month rotation in early August. Two Spanish F-18s shot down a drone on 16 August and scrambled again on 6 October; the targets did not enter Romanian airspace that day (Euronews). Base coordinates: OurAirports (LRCK).

punti.nome: Romanian F-16s from Borcea shot down two Geran drones
punti.note: Romanian Ministry of Defence: on 17 October two F-16s from Borcea destroyed two jet-powered Geran drones south-east and east of Sulina, after they entered Romanian airspace from about 120 km east of Snake Island. Their target is not confirmed. Base coordinates: OurAirports (LRFT).

punti.nome: Swedish Gripens protect the Rzeszów-Jasionka hub
punti.note: From 1 October, for two months, Gripens of the F 17 wing contribute to the protection of the Rzeszów-Jasionka hub that supplies Ukraine, under CAOC Uedem. They fly mainly from Sweden with a small forward base in Poland; the number of aircraft was not given (Swedish government and Armed Forces, via AeroTime). Base coordinates: OurAirports (EPRZ).

punti.nome: Italian Task Force Air at Taif: one F-2000 hit
punti.note: Italy's Task Force Air at Taif had four F-2000A Eurofighters, an E-550 CAEW and C-130J/KC-130J support. One F-2000 was hit in overnight attacks on the base reported on 18 September; no Italian casualties. The CAEW MM62303 was last traced at Taif on 21 September and was back over Italy on 12 October. Base coordinates: OurAirports (OETF).
